entries.value: A major official was executed or exiled for treason
A critically-necessary heir was born, or confirmed, or announced
A chief minister fell rapidly from grace
A high noble made openly rebellious noises
A major faith was offended by the lord's actions
An allied lord was angered by some act of the court
An enemy's spy ring was revealed operating inside the court
A vast governmental project was announced — a campaign, a fortress, a pilgrimage
Corrupt officials plundered a great plan and it has failed
A new council, charter, or institution was formed
A heavy levy was imposed on the people to deal with some crisis
A general or warlord was dismissed for incompetence or insubordination
A folk hero rose to dangerous popularity among the common people
A major infrastructure project was begun — a road, a bridge, a church
A fief or territory was put in new hands, angering the previous holder's kin
Certain merchants or nobles were ruined by fines or seizure of their goods
A terrorist attack by rebels, Saxon agents, or faerie agents
A major faction of court officials collapsed or was purged
A significant privilege or exemption was revoked
Province or hundred borders were redrawn, causing local fury
